headline: NSI Reports 0.2% Deflation in September, Inflation at 5.7%
summary: Bulgarian consumer prices fell 0.2% month on month in September, while annual price growth accelerated from August to 5.7%. Entertainment, sports and culture were the cheapest categories.
why: Consumer inflation data guides central bank and government policy, and it affects bond yields and real wage trends. Annual rates show the underlying price pressure over time.
